name: Creator
desc: The main all-around hero. Balanced combos with beat and music energy. Best starter character for the nightlife quest.
style: Balanced all-rounder with music-energy combat. Good at everything, master of nothing — perfect for learning the system.
specialDesc: Releases a pulse of music energy that staggers nearby enemies.
super1Desc: Energizes the crowd — all enemies take 1.5x damage for 4 seconds.
super2Desc: Throws mic stand through a line of enemies dealing heavy damage.
super3Desc: Fully restores HP and enters a powered-up state for 6 seconds.

name: DJ
desc: Rhythm-based fighter with soundwave specials and crowd-control supers. Medium speed, medium weight.
style: Controls space with soundwave projectiles. Rhythm timing buffs combo damage. Strong in groups.
specialDesc: Fires a bass wave that travels across the screen, damaging all enemies it hits.
super1Desc: Massive soundwave explosion — stuns all enemies on screen for 3 seconds.
super2Desc: Locks onto one enemy dealing rapid sound damage — ignores defense.
super3Desc: Summons 3 audio pillars that deal continuous area damage for 5 seconds.

name: FAMU Student A
desc: Fast confident striker with quick combos and school-pride energy. Agile and relentless.
style: Pure rushdown pressure. Fastest normal combos in the game. Weak defense — all offense, no mercy.
specialDesc: Dashes forward striking rapidly 5 times in quick succession.
super1Desc: School-pride aura temporarily boosts all stats by 50% for 5 seconds.
super2Desc: Sprint attack that carries an enemy across the stage for massive damage.
super3Desc: Calls in the whole squad — enemies are bombarded from all sides.

name: FAMU Student B
desc: Balanced but flashy fighter with strong dash attacks and team-energy supers.
style: Momentum-based fighter. Gains damage as combo count rises. Strong dash cancels and team synergies.
specialDesc: Electric-charged dash attack that hits multiple times through enemies.
super1Desc: Lightning strikes hit all enemies — higher combo count = more strikes.
super2Desc: Charges up and releases a powerful shockwave in all directions.
super3Desc: Briefly creates a copy of yourself — both attack simultaneously for 4 seconds.

name: Influencer
desc: Evasive fighter with flash, camera, and status effects. Confusion and stun specials. Fast and light.
style: Slippery dodge-based fighter. Uses flash effects to blind and confuse. Hard to pin down, punishes overextension.
specialDesc: Camera flash blinds all nearby enemies — they miss attacks for 3 seconds.
super1Desc: Posts a clip — enemies become stunned watching their own defeat.
super2Desc: Stuns one enemy and deals massive isolated damage — great for bosses.
super3Desc: Enters 'main character mode' — all attacks become cinematic for 5 seconds with 2x damage.

name: Photographer
desc: Precision fighter with camera flash stun and range-control mechanics. Tactical and methodical.
style: Zoning and range control. Flash stun creates openings. Punishes reckless approaches with precise counter-hits.
specialDesc: Fires a ranged flash shot that stuns any enemy it hits.
super1Desc: Slows all enemies to half speed for 5 seconds — perfect for combos.
super2Desc: Large-area flash that stuns all on-screen enemies simultaneously.
super3Desc: Rapid-fire camera shots deal precision damage — each shot crits on stunned enemies.

name: Promoter
desc: Crowd-control style fighter with push/pull enemy movement and hype meter mechanics.
style: Manipulates enemy positions. Pushes crowds away or pulls isolated targets in. Strongest utility fighter in the roster.
specialDesc: Releases hype energy — pushes enemies back and boosts own meter gain for 6 seconds.
super1Desc: Pulls all enemies to center stage, then detonates in a burst of confetti damage.
super2Desc: Charges through enemies like a crowd surge, dealing damage to each.
super3Desc: Venue goes sold out — enemies panic and deal reduced damage while taking more.

name: Dancer
desc: Fastest close-range fighter with spin attacks and dodge-heavy combo extension style.
style: Spin-based offense with extended combos. Dodges flow directly into attacks. Hardest to learn, highest skill ceiling.
specialDesc: Spinning kick that hits all surrounding enemies — combo multiplier applies.
super1Desc: Rapid pose sequence dealing 10 hits across all nearby enemies.
super2Desc: Commands the room — enemies are unable to block for 4 seconds.
super3Desc: Legendary dance sequence — massive area damage and full meter refill.

name: Vendor
desc: Heavy utility fighter with item toss and cart/tray style attacks. Higher durability.
style: Item-based zoning with heavy melee backup. Cart rams and tray swipes deal area damage. Tanky with surprise range.
specialDesc: Hurls a heavy serving tray across the stage dealing damage on both throw and return.
super1Desc: Rams enemies with a full cart — heavy knockback and area damage.
super2Desc: Drops heavy inventory from above onto all on-screen enemies.
super3Desc: Sweeps the venue clean — massive horizontal slam clears the entire screen.

name: Security
desc: Heavy grappler and tank with throws, pushes, and crowd removal. Best defense in the roster.
style: Dominant grappler — grabs and throws deal massive damage. Blocks almost everything. Slowest but most durable.
specialDesc: Grabs the nearest enemy and throws them into others — chain knockback.
super1Desc: Slams down creating an impassable barrier — enemies bounce off for 5 seconds.
super2Desc: Grabs up to 3 enemies and slams them simultaneously for huge damage.
super3Desc: Enters maximum security mode — invincible for 3 seconds with amplified throws.

name: Host
desc: Mic-command fighter with buffs, callouts, and stun commands. Balanced support and combat.
style: Command-based fighter — mic callouts apply status effects. Can buff self or debuff enemies. Versatile in any situation.
specialDesc: Throws the mic — enemy hit is stunned and takes 50% more damage for 4 seconds.
super1Desc: Works the crowd — generates a burst of energy that heals 30% HP.
super2Desc: Time limit announcement stresses all enemies, reducing their attack by 40%.
super3Desc: Takes the stage — massive presence attack deals damage to all enemies.

name: FSU Student A
desc: Aggressive rushdown fighter with strong momentum attacks and fast pressure.
style: Non-stop pressure machine. Once momentum starts, it never stops. Loves cornering enemies against walls.
specialDesc: High-speed rushing combo — velocity increases damage the further it travels.
super1Desc: Intimidation blast — all enemies flinch and lose 25% of their max HP.
super2Desc: Sprint across the full stage dealing damage to every enemy in the path.
super3Desc: Goes unconquerable — all attacks become unblockable for 5 seconds.

name: FSU Student B
desc: Balanced technical fighter with counter timing and dodge mechanics. Strong finisher timing.
style: Technical counter-puncher. Perfect blocks trigger powerful counters. Patient and precise — rewards discipline.
specialDesc: Parry window — a perfectly timed activation counters any attack with 3x damage.
super1Desc: Tag-team counter sequence — reflects all damage taken back at attackers.
super2Desc: Precise multi-hit sequence targeting weaknesses — ignores 50% of defense.
super3Desc: Final exam — locks onto boss/strongest enemy and delivers a devastating technical combo.

name: Kendrick
desc: Cafe8Fifty's own. Lyric-sharp footwork and kitchen-bred power. Hometown headliner of the opening stage.
style: Technical pressure fighter — fast rushdown strings that cancel into heavy finishers. Rewards rhythm.
specialDesc: A spinning advancing strike that carries through a line of enemies.
super1Desc: Quick flurry combo that builds meter fast.
super2Desc: Slams the mic stand down for a heavy shockwave.
super3Desc: Powered-up state: faster combos and bonus damage for 6 seconds.
